item.title: Whiskers 0.8.53
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.53

### File Transcription

  • Improved file transcription for long audio and video files so large jobs use less memory and are less likely to fail
  • Improved cloud file transcription so long files are processed in smaller pieces instead of waiting on one large upload
  • Improved file transcription recovery so interrupted, missing, or partially completed jobs are cleaned up more reliably

    • ### Recording Reliability

  • Improved Bluetooth microphone startup so recording waits for stable audio before starting, reducing false starts from noisy or waking devices
  • Improved live dictation responsiveness by reducing background work during launch and recording

    • ### Setup & Support

  • Added smarter API key naming and direct setup guidance when adding provider keys
  • Improved support diagnostics so audio interruptions are easier to diagnose without including recordings or transcript text

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a local model preparation message that could appear unnecessarily in the recording HUD
